Your Cruise Options

Two Ships, Two Departure Ports — Same Great Caribbean

I've put together two options for your trip: Symphony of the Seas departing from Galveston — no flights, drive straight to the port — or Icon of the Seas departing from Miami, the world's largest cruise ship with the most onboard amenities of any vessel at sea. Both are Royal Caribbean, both are Western Caribbean itineraries, both have the same cabin categories. Pick the sailing that works best for you, select your cabin, and I'll take it from there.

A note on pricing

Individual components in your quote are priced at publicly available rates — and in many cases lower than what you'd find on your own. You don't have to worry about overpaying for a piece of your trip. What you're paying for is the rest: the right cabin, an operator we know and trust, and a human who answers when something doesn't go to plan.
